subject: Ciências
description_pt: Planejar e executar experimentos que evidenciem que todas as cores de luz podem ser formadas pela composição das três cores primárias da luz e que a cor de um objeto está relacionada também à cor da luz que o ilumina.

components.description_pt: Demonstrar experimentalmente que três cores primárias de luz combinam para produzir todas outras cores
components.description_en: Demonstrate through experimentation that the three primary colors of light combine to produce all other colors
components.cc_component_description: Explain how the wave model of light accounts for the perception of color through frequency differences

components.description_pt: Investigar como cor da luz iluminando objeto afeta sua cor aparente
components.description_en: Investigate how the color of light illuminating an object affects its apparent color
components.cc_component_description: Explain how the frequency of light influences whether it is reflected, absorbed, or transmitted by a given material

components.description_pt: Planejar e realizar experimentos para testar propriedades de mistura de cores de luz
components.description_en: Plan and conduct experiments to test the properties of light color mixing
components.cc_component_description: Plan an investigation to test how objects made of different materials interact with a beam of light

cc_matches.description: A wave model of light is useful for explaining brightness, color, and the frequency-dependent bending of light at a surface between media.
When light shines on an object, it is reflected, absorbed, or transmitted through the object, depending on the object’s material and the frequency (color) of the light.
Plan and conduct investigations to determine the effect of placing objects made with different materials in the path of a beam of light.
